Its FAQ then drops the restrictions: "The ATA survey ruled out any transmitter stronger than roughly 10 to 110 watts across 1 to 9 GHz." The paper's limit holds for the frequencies it kept and the drift rates it kept.

title: A Firm No: What the 3I/ATLAS Radio Searches Could See (EA-3I-ATLAS-PUBLIC-01 v1.0)
sentence: Loeb's graded position travelled as a concession he never made.
